correctness.rationale: Fresh independently written Q(sqrt3) arithmetic rebuilt all twelve side lines, 66 seed intersection points, 913 candidate joins and exactly 49 richness>=4 lines. All 1176 pairs give char-zero histogram (204,96,6,24,6,12,1), total 349 and Σ choose(m,2)n_m=1176. Primitive integral triples have coordinate-norm gcd and pair-cross coordinate-norm gcd supported only at 2,3, ensuring line survival/distinctness at p>=5. Independently enumerated all 18424 unordered triples: 1120 zero determinants; 60 distinct nonzero determinant norms, max 1944, combined prime support {2,3,11,13}. Thus no new triple dependencies for p>=5 except 11,13; zero dependencies persist. Reductions at both roots sqrt3=±5 mod11 and ±4 mod13 give precisely the stated profiles, with 133 and 169 points and weighted pair counts 1176. p23 split-field control gives original profile. Exhaustiveness over determinant norms proves all p>=5, not sampled primes.

value.rationale: Good/bad reduction of a rigid, well-studied 49-line arithmetic arrangement is a natural integral-matroid invariant. Determining precisely which two odd primes alter its geometric intersection lattice, with complete multiplicity distributions, is a mathematically useful exact arithmetic classification; it distinguishes modular degeneration from characteristic-zero freeness/rigidity. This involves a genuine all-primes finite determinant norm certificate, not arbitrary sampling.
residual_risks: The invariant is model-specific and does not classify all alternative integral models or positive-characteristic free arrangements.

final_claim: For the fixed 49-line dodecagon arrangement O_49 over Q(sqrt3), reduced through its integral coefficient model, every prime p>=5 retains 49 distinct geometric lines. The geometric intersection lattice is unchanged from characteristic zero except at p=11,13, whose multiplicity baskets are exactly (n2,n3,n4,n5,n6,n7,n12)=(24,12,18,60,6,12,1) and (0,96,30,12,18,12,1), respectively.
